_readme: The one description of what a crate repository is configured to be. script/apply-settings applies it with gh api and refuses a setting the API rejects, never silently skips it. script/check-settings reads the live settings back and fails on any difference, so a setting changed by hand in the web interface is a red run. Names here are provisional until calef's naming pass.

metadata.description: A standalone nifeos crate: proven with Kani, released through the shared workflows

actions._readme: Every third-party action the template itself uses is named in patterns_allowed, or the caller's allowlist refuses the whole reusable workflow at resolution: startup_failure with empty referenced_workflows, measured on the canary, where taiki-e/install-action (used by check and weekly) was missing and took the two workflows down with it.

tags: only the release workflow makes one
rulesets._readme: A repository-level tag ruleset is accepted (measured 2026-10-17 on the canary); a push-target ruleset refuses ref_name conditions. The only bypass actor is the nife-smelter app (actor_id 5053502), which the release workflow's tag job authenticates as. The GitHub Actions integration (15368) is refused as a bypass actor ('must be part of the ruleset source or owner organization'), so github.token cannot tag. The app is accepted once it is installed on the repository. A hand-made v* tag is refused with a 422; a tag that does not match v* is allowed.
